class_features.portent: Roll 2 d20s after long rest to replace future rolls.
class_features.divination_savant: Halved time/gold to copy divination spells.

world_data.current_location: Sariel's Chambers, House Arcanus Wing, Zenith Spire, Aeterna.

core_memories: Sariel, consumed by guilt over her mother's death, seeks purpose by vowing to honor Alexiel's sacrifice, guided by Cressida.

Sariel discovers the Null Genesis Project, learning her mother, Alexiel, was a hidden magical prodigy whose 'Null' status was a lifelong deception. She uncovers the existence of the 'Joyful Predator' trait within her bloodline, tied to Lucifer's celestial essence.
Sariel reaches Level 2 (Wizard, School of Divination), gaining Portent and Divination Savant.
Sariel uncovers records detailing Alexiel's personal development of the Nullification Field and her 'Joyful Predator' trait, realizing her mother was a master of hidden power and deception.
